title: 第23章 神秘少年第24章 叶如龙
slug: 惊天剑帝第7906章空气太敏感
content_zh:
“难道这蛇心毒就没有办法解吗？灵犀城最大的藏宝楼，也没有办法吗？”林白好奇的问道。
“我不知道，藏宝楼的东西，都太贵了，我被废之后，林家对我的态度你也看见了。”
“林泰恒是恨不得我死，他又怎么会拿钱出来给我买解药呢？”
林跃苦笑连连的说道。
“该死的林泰恒！三叔，你别急，我去藏宝楼看看。”
林白说道。
藏宝楼，是灵犀城中最大的交易会所。
在神武国中，藏宝楼的分店也是很多。
虽然此刻已经快到午夜了，但藏宝楼依旧是人满为患的一个状态。
因为明日就要开始比武收徒了，很多武者都想来购买一些强大的武技和兵刃，为明日做准备。
“这位少侠，我是藏宝楼的侍女艾琳，不知道有什么可以帮到您的吗？”林白刚刚走入藏宝楼，便有一个侍女带着春风般的笑容走过来。
“我想问问藏宝楼可有解除蛇心毒的解药？”林白直言不讳的问道。
“蛇心毒？是五毒教中的三大奇毒之一？”艾琳好奇的问道。
“应该是吧。”林白也不确定。
如果不是林跃今日提起蛇心毒，林白根本不知道还有这种毒药。
“对不起了，少侠，蛇心毒是五毒教的三大奇毒，在五毒教被覆灭之时，解药就一起毁掉了。”
“藏宝楼虽然曾经也有收藏，但现在都已经卖完了。”
艾琳摇头说道。
“是这样啊。”林白有些落寞的说道。
“那少侠，你可否还需要其他的东西呢？兵刃，武技，灵药，藏宝楼都有。”艾琳问道。

林白有些失落的摇头。
藏宝楼都没有解蛇心毒的解药，那看来只有等我去了四大宗门后，在想办法帮三叔解毒了。
林白如是想道。
“这位大哥，请问你是想要蛇心毒的解药嘛？”正当林白失落的时候，在背后一个弱弱的声音传来。
林白惊讶的回头一看，一个骨瘦如柴的少年，用一双怯懦的眼神看着他。
“是的。”林白点头道。
“我这里有借蛇心毒的解药。”这少年从斜挂着的布袋中摸了摸，取出了一个黄木铸造成的烂木头盒子，递给林白。
林白接过来一看，里面有两个黑色的丹药，卖相不好看，但却的确有着一丝药香。
“你这丹药怎么卖？”林白问道。
“我不要钱，但我想要一把兵器，就是那一把。”少年用手指一指，让林白看见了藏宝楼墙壁上挂着的一柄生锈的剑。
一把生锈的剑？
“这把剑怎么卖？”林白对艾琳问道。
“这把剑来之不易，当初藏宝楼收购的时候，就花费了一千灵石。”
“所以，如果少侠想要买这把剑，出价至少不能低于一千灵石。”艾琳轻笑着说道。
“一千灵石……”林白一听，这特么的一把破剑，值一千灵石？
灵石，是武者之间交易的货币。
灵石是天地之中天然诞生出来的矿石，石头内蕴藏着强大的灵气。
武者可以直接用灵石内的灵气来修炼，所以灵石在武道界流传十分的广。
一听一千灵石，林白犹豫了。
且不说这一千灵石，对林白无关紧要，但是这解药还需要多多考究。
content_en:
"Is there no way to cure this snake heart poison? Is there no way to cure the largest treasure house in Lingxi City?" Lin Bai asked curiously.
"I don't know, the things in the treasure house are too expensive. You have also seen the Lin family's attitude towards me after I was deposed."
"Lin Taiheng wants me to die, so why would he use the money to buy me the antidote?"
Lin Yue said with a wry smile.
"Damn Lin Taiheng! Third uncle, don't worry, I'll go to the treasure house to take a look."
Lin Bai said.
Treasure House is the largest trading center in Lingxi City.
In Shenwu Kingdom, there are also many branches of Zangbaolou.
Although it was almost midnight, the treasure house was still overcrowded.
Because the competition to recruit disciples will begin tomorrow, many warriors want to buy some powerful martial arts and weapons to prepare for tomorrow.
"This young hero, I am Irene, the maid of the treasure house. Is there anything I can help you with?" As soon as Lin Bai entered the treasure house, a maid came over with a spring breeze smile.
"I would like to ask if the treasure house has an antidote to the snake heart poison?" Lin Bai asked bluntly.
"Snake heart poison? Is it one of the three strange poisons in the Five Poison Sect?" Irene asked curiously.
"It should be so." Lin Bai was not sure either.
If Lin Yue hadn't mentioned snake heart poison today, Lin Bai wouldn't have known there was such a poison at all.
"I'm sorry, young hero, snake heart poison is one of the three strange poisons of the Five Poison Sect. When the Five Poison Sect was destroyed, the antidote was also destroyed."
"Although the treasure house once had a collection, they are all sold out now."
Erin shook her head and said.
"That's right." Lin Bai said a little lonely.
"So young hero, do you need anything else? Weapons, martial arts, elixirs, and a treasure house are all available." Irene asked.
Lin Bai shook his head in disappointment.
There is no antidote for snake heart poison in the treasure house, so it seems that I will have to wait until I go to the four major sects to find a way to help Third Uncle detoxify.
Lin Bai thought so.
"Brother, do you want the antidote for snake heart poison?" Just when Lin Bai was feeling lost, a weak voice came from behind.
Lin Bai looked back in surprise, and saw a skinny young man looking at him with a pair of timid eyes.
"Yes." Lin Bai nodded.
"I have an antidote for snake heart poison here." The young man felt from the cloth bag hanging sideways, took out a rotten wooden box made of yellow wood, and handed it to Lin Bai.
Lin Bai took it and took a look. There were two black elixirs inside. They didn't look good, but they did have a hint of medicinal fragrance.
"How do you sell this elixir?" Lin Bai asked.
"I don't want money, but I want a weapon, that one." The young man pointed with his finger, letting Lin Bai see a rusty sword hanging on the wall of the treasure building.
A rusty sword?
"How can I sell this sword?" Lin Bai asked Irene.
"This sword is hard-earned. When the Treasure House purchased it, it cost a thousand spiritual stones."
"So, if the young hero wants to buy this sword, the price must be at least one thousand spirit stones." Irene said with a chuckle.
"A thousand spirit stones..." When Lin Bai heard this, he thought, such a broken sword is worth a thousand spirit stones?
Spiritual stones are the currency traded between warriors.
Spiritual stones are minerals naturally born in heaven and earth. The stones contain powerful spiritual energy.
Warriors can directly use the spiritual energy in spiritual stones to practice, so spiritual stones are widely spread in the martial arts world.
When Lin Bai heard about a thousand spiritual stones, he hesitated.
Not to mention that these thousand spirit stones were insignificant to Lin Bai, but this antidote still required more research.
